recommendations.evidence: Iubenda and Cookiebot each found one actionable Options control but its aria-controls target was absent before opening; Termly retained two actionable candidates; TrustArc retained none. Five dependent checks are incomplete per site, 20 total.
recommendations.proposal: Add reviewed canonical panel lifecycle bindings and control-scope resolution using retained evidence plus deterministic fixtures. Keep exact-target and unique-action guards; do not arbitrarily choose or force-click controls.
recommendations.impact: 20 blocked checks are a potential coverage opportunity, not a promise of 20 resolved checks.

recommendations.evidence: Preference capture reports cmp_identity_ambiguous; first-layer and action capture are also limited.
recommendations.proposal: Inspect exact matching provider scopes and separate active CMP UI from inactive or demo surfaces. Retain identities and match provenance. Do not prefer a provider because of the target hostname.

recommendations.evidence: 41 of 61 unresolved checks concern categories, services, declaration comparison, unmatched names, or cookie information. These overlap the preference-access opportunity above. OneTrust retained a bounded partial configuration; CookieYes retained loaded configuration without visibility or completeness proof.
recommendations.proposal: Extend bounded canonical inventory adapters and retain declared names, purposes, durations and completeness independently. Do not infer undeclared cookies from a partial inventory or treat an inferred purpose as a declared purpose.

recommendations.evidence: Seven comparisons remain unresolved. Cookiebot retained an 80ms comparison timeout followed by no remaining allowance. CookieYes and OneTrust retain pair_not_unique diagnostics; several other captures remain deferred. Six report rows omit the explanatory detail.
recommendations.proposal: Review canonical candidate pairing and existing-budget scheduling; carry verified failure reasons through the typed assessment. Preserve unknown results when a valid comparison is absent.
